patches.name: GmsCore support
patches.description: Allows Google Maps to run without root and without Google Play services, by using MicroG-RE under a different package name.

options.description: The package name of the patched app. It must differ from the original Google Maps package name. Changing it later installs a separate app instead of updating the existing one.
